newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse still sees 1997 results above '96.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse still sees 1997 results above '96.

text.p: Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG on Tuesday confirmed that it still expects net profit in 1997 to exceed 1996's 417 million Swiss francs.

"For 1997, we again expect an improvement in group results compared with 1996," outgoing chief executive officer Theodor Tshopp said in the text of a statement prepared for the company's annual shareholder meeting.
Tschopp is expected to be elected as chairman at today's shareholder meeting and be succeeded as CEO by current chief financial officer Sergio Marchionne.
Tschopp will be taking over as chairman of the board from Hans Jucker.
Tschopp's comments reiterated a statement made at the company's annual press conference on February 11.
